name: @clawdhq/custody-db
description: Shared Prisma schema/client for non-trading server-custodied signing keys (Subscriptions' per-subscription wallets now, the x402 facilitator later) — isolated from marketplace-db, social-db, and degen-db because it's another schema that holds encrypted private key material, same reasoning degen-db's own isolation documents

scripts.build: prisma generate && tsup && rm -rf dist/generated && cp -R src/generated dist/generated && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: echo "no unit tests — this package is schema + a generated client"
